deleteBody.categories: The category leaves the menu and the POS. Past orders keep it. This can't be undone from the POS.
deleteBody.products: The product and its variants leave the menu and the POS. Past orders keep them, with the prices they were charged. This can't be undone from the POS.
deleteBody.variants: This variant leaves the POS. Past orders keep it, with the price it was charged. If it is the product's last variant, the product leaves the POS until a new one is added.
deleteBody.addons: The add-on is no longer offered on any product. Past orders keep it, with the price it was charged. This can't be undone from the POS.

discover.title: Explore what's next for Engineers Pizza POS
discover.lead: Your POS already runs orders, the menu, sales reports and finance. These are the modules being planned next — ideas to help you control costs, bring customers back and run busy shifts with less effort.
discover.disclaimer: Everything on this page is planned and not part of your current POS. Previews are illustrative and contain no real data. No release dates have been set.
discover.featuredHint: A closer look at a few of the modules on the plan.
discover.browseHint: Browse by area, or search for what matters most to your restaurant.
discover.emptyTitle: No planned capability matches your search
discover.emptyHint: Try another word, or show every area.
discover.calloutTitle: Which of these would help your restaurant most?
discover.calloutBody: Nothing here is scheduled yet. Share which modules matter most to you with the team that looks after your POS — that feedback helps decide what gets built first.

finance.title: Profit and food-cost insights
finance.body: Future modules could put your costs next to these sales — profit day by day, food cost by item and sales estimates. They are not available yet.

menu.title: Ingredient stock and recipe costing
menu.body: Future modules could track the stock of your ingredients and show what each dish costs to make. They are not available yet.

inventory.title: Inventory & Purchasing
inventory.description: Know what you have, what it costs and what to order.

insights.title: Business Intelligence
insights.description: See the profit behind your sales, not just the sales.

operations.title: Operations & Staff
operations.description: Smoother shifts, from the kitchen to the dining room.

delivery.title: Delivery & Digital Ordering
delivery.description: Take more orders online and deliver them with confidence.

stock.title: Ingredient Stock Tracking
stock.description: Keep a running count of dough, cheese and toppings as orders are sold, so you know what's on the shelf.

lowStock.title: Low Stock Alerts
lowStock.description: Get a heads-up before an ingredient runs out — not in the middle of the dinner rush.

recipeCosting.title: Recipe Costing
recipeCosting.description: See what every pizza, size and add-on costs to make, built on the ingredient lists already in your menu.
recipeCosting.highlight3: See how ingredient price changes affect each dish

suppliers.title: Supplier Management
suppliers.description: Keep suppliers, their prices and contact details in one place instead of scattered notes.

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase Orders
purchaseOrders.description: Prepare supplier orders from what's running low, and check off what has arrived.

waste.title: Waste Tracking
waste.description: Record spoiled or discarded ingredients to see where money is being thrown away.

crm.title: Customer Profiles
crm.description: Go beyond a name and phone number: see each regular's order history, favourites and notes before taking their order.

loyalty.title: Loyalty Points
loyalty.description: Reward repeat visits with points customers can redeem — one more reason to choose you again.
loyalty.highlight3: See who your most loyal customers are

giftCards.title: Gift Cards
giftCards.description: Sell gift cards in the restaurant and accept them as payment at the till.

sms.title: SMS Campaigns
sms.description: Tell customers who agreed to hear from you about a new pizza or a quiet-night offer.

segments.title: Customer Segmentation
segments.description: Group customers by how often and how much they order, and speak to each group differently.

birthdays.title: Birthday Offers
birthdays.description: Surprise customers who share their birthday with you with a small treat on their day.

profitLoss.title: Profit & Loss Dashboard
profitLoss.description: Put your costs next to your sales to see what each day, week and month actually earns.
profitLoss.highlight1: Sales, costs and profit side by side
profitLoss.highlight3: Built on the sales the POS already records

foodCost.title: Food Cost Analysis
foodCost.description: Compare what dishes cost to make with what they sell for, by item and by category.

forecasting.title: Sales Forecasting
forecasting.description: Estimate busy days and hours from your past sales, to plan dough, stock and staff ahead.

branches.title: Branch Comparison
branches.description: For when you open another location: compare sales and costs across branches side by side.

highlights.title: Business Highlights
highlights.description: A short summary of what changed — busiest hours, best sellers and unusual dips — without digging through reports.

goals.title: Performance Goals
goals.description: Set targets for sales or orders and follow the progress through the week.

kds.title: Kitchen Display System
kds.description: Show new orders on a kitchen screen alongside — or instead of — paper tickets, with a timer on every order.
kds.highlight1: Orders appear the moment they are placed
kds.highlight2: Preparing and ready at a glance
kds.highlight3: Timers that flag orders running late

tables.title: Table Management
tables.description: See which tables are free, seated or waiting for the bill, and link dine-in orders to them.

scheduling.title: Staff Scheduling
scheduling.description: Plan the week's shifts and see who is working when, in one shared schedule.

attendance.title: Employee Attendance
attendance.description: Record when staff start and finish their shifts, ready for payroll.

reconciliation.title: Shift Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Count the cash drawer at the end of a shift and compare it with that shift's sales.

workflows.title: Operational Checklists
workflows.description: Opening, closing and cleaning checklists your team ticks off on screen.

drivers.title: Driver Management
drivers.description: Assign delivery orders to drivers and see who is out and who is back.

liveTracking.title: Live Delivery Tracking
liveTracking.description: Follow orders from the oven to the customer's door, so you can answer “where is my order?” in seconds.
liveTracking.highlight1: Every delivery's progress on a map
liveTracking.highlight2: An estimated arrival time to share with the customer
liveTracking.highlight3: Quick answers when a customer calls

website.title: Online Ordering Website
website.description: Let customers order directly from your own website, with your menu and prices kept in step with the POS.
website.highlight1: Your menu, your prices, your brand
website.highlight2: Orders arrive in the POS like any other

qr.title: QR Table Ordering
qr.description: Guests scan a code at their table to order — and the order goes straight to the kitchen.

statusScreen.title: Order Status Screen
statusScreen.description: A screen in the restaurant showing which orders are being prepared and which are ready for pickup.

zones.title: Delivery Zone Management
zones.description: Draw your delivery areas once and apply each zone's delivery fee automatically.
